zh: 你的脑子最好比这个计时器转得还快
这一秒的学费，已经到账了
走神一分钟，大概等于一杯奶茶
认真听讲是回本的唯一方式
教授讲的每一页 PPT 都是付费内容
睡着也计费，醒着更划算
不懂就问，问题不收额外费用
这节课结束前，争取把它学成自己的
en: Your brain had better spin faster than this counter
This second's tuition has already been paid
One minute of daydreaming is roughly one bubble tea
Paying attention is the only way to break even
Every slide in this lecture is premium content
Sleeping is billed too. Staying awake is better value
Questions are included in the price. Ask away
Make this class yours before it ends
